case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP.
To be fully transparent with you:
Thank you for your revised proposal.
While we appreciate your slight increase, we are unable to reduce our price further for DAP delivery.
Our whole team is ready, and we will do everything to make you a satisfied customer.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

reasons: Thank you for your revised proposal.
While we appreciate your slight increase, we are unable to reduce our price further for DAP delivery.

move.text:
Dear partner,
Many thanks for your reply; we really appreciate the chance to work with you.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP.
Please let me explain.
Thank you for your revised proposal and the continued increase in your price.
Please note that 28 days is our absolute minimum feasible lead time.
Any further step needs approval from our management.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.
We are a competitive and flexible partner.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Hallo,
thanks for the mail.
this is our last price, take it or leave it.
Our terms: a price of €16.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 21 days, delivery DAP.
Here is how it is:
I can meet you at 16.00 EUR, but my machines don't run on air.
Let's lock in 16.00 EUR so we can start making chips.
We calculate tight, there is not much air in our prices.
Just write if something is unclear.
Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH
